root_cause_criterion.description: After writing to glyph_to_cache_index at index j, the vector's logical size must be at least j+1. The vulnerable code uses operator[] which does not update size; the fix uses push_back() which increments size.

nodes.description: At the write to glyph_to_cache_index[j], the vector's logical size (0) is less than the write position plus one (j+1), confirming a container-overflow WRITE.

edges.description: reserve(word->getLength()) at line 462 does not change the vector's logical size; the size at the subsequent write (line 478) remains 0, identical to the post-reserve size.
word->getLength() used in reserve() is the same value that bounds the inner glyph loop (j < word->getLength()), driving iteration to the overflow site.
